description.value: Hime Sushi is a Japanese restaurant on East Broadway in Vancouver, serving an extensive menu of sushi rolls, nigiri, sashimi, and cooked Japanese dishes such as tonkatsu and chicken karaage. The restaurant is open daily and offers both dine-in and takeout, with delivery also available through third-party services. It sits on a busy commercial corridor convenient to cyclists riding the Broadway route.
